subject: Model mix & token volumes — follow up from discovery
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chen <schen@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Model mix & token volumes (post-discovery)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and a few asks so we can get a pricing estimate and recommended model-mix plan to you: 

What we covered (brief):
- Current use cases: chat-based customer support (primary), similarity search for content (embeddings), occasional reranking for search results.
- Integration: backend API calls from BrightLayer services, expect to proxy through our Dedicated pool initially.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 in place, need a short questionnaire for procurement.

Asks / info needed to finalize estimate:
1) Token volumes (monthly) by model type — approximate ranges are fine. Please split between chat (user + assistant tokens), embeddings (units or tokens), and rerank requests.
2) Target budget range or monthly commit you’re comfortable with (helps pick Dedicated vs. hosted mix).
3) Any SLA or latency targets that are stricter than standard (e.g., p95 <200ms) — noted in our follow-ups.

For context, we typically show unit economics as $/1M tokens per model-class and then forecast monthly spend and recommended model mix to hit your latency/budget tradeoffs.

Next steps: if you can reply with the token split and budget range, I will send a short pricing estimate + example cost scenarios (hosted vs. dedicated + mixed routing) and a suggested rollout plan. I’ll attach an initial estimate and a simple spreadsheet you can edit.

Thanks — talk soon.
—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0138

Attachments: BL-MAAP_token-volumes.xlsx (spreadsheet stub for your volumes)

From: Sarah Chen <schen@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightlayer.com
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Model mix & token volumes (post-discovery)

Thanks Marissa — great summary. Quick answers below (ballpark numbers for now):

- Chat (customer support, includes user + assistant tokens): ~200M tokens/month (this is the dominant usage).
- Embeddings (semantic search & similarity): ~50M tokens/month (we batch vectorization nightly; units here represent input tokens processed).
- Rerank (search result reranking): ~10M tokens/month (smaller, but latency-sensitive for a subset).

Budget: internal range we’re considering is $10k–$15k/month to start. If you can show a path where we get to predictable costs and meaningful latency improvements, we can stretch to higher commits in Q3.

SLA/latency: for chat p95 we’d like <300ms where possible; rerank ideally <150ms for top-tier queries.

I’ll also loop procurement once we have an initial estimate. Leaving procurement cc’d.

Sarah
Sarah Chen | Head of ML Platforms
BrightLayer
schen@brightlayer.com

Subject: RE: Follow-up: Model mix & token volumes (post-discovery)

Hi Sarah — appreciate the numbers, that’s perfect to start. Based on the volumes you shared (200M chat / 50M embeddings / 10M rerank) and your $10k–$15k/month target, I ran a few quick unit-economics scenarios and attached a short estimate PDF plus the filled spreadsheet. High-level guidance below:

Quick unit economics (example, illustrative):
- Chat model (prod chat variant): $14 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings (batched vectorization): $3.50 / 1M tokens
- Rerank (low-latency variant): $22 / 1M tokens

Projected monthly cost (simple multiply):
- Chat: 200M tokens -> ~$2,800/month
- Embeddings: 50M tokens -> ~$175/month
- Rerank: 10M tokens -> ~$220/month
- Raw total estimate: ~$3,195/month (hosted per-token example)

Notes and recommended model mix:
- You’re well under the stated $10k–$15k band on raw per-token hosted pricing; this gives us room to recommend Dedicated for predictable latency and lower unit cost at scale (we can structure a commit that reduces unit $/1M).
- Suggested rollout: start hosted for non-critical flows and move chat + rerank to Dedicated mirrors for low-latency SLAs. Keep embeddings batched on lower-cost nodes or a mixed routing to control spend.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf (2-page estimate), BL-MAAP_token-volumes.xlsx (filled)

Next steps:
1) I’ll prepare a Dedicated sizing + commit proposal showing breakpoint economics for $/1M at 1M, 5M, 10M token tiers (we can model a plan that hits your Q3 growth target).
2) If procurement wants SOC2 / contract terms, I can loop Legal and send the questionnaire + typical SOW language.
3) Quick tech sync with Vivek to validate latency routing and canary plan (30 min).

Would you be available for a 30-min tech + pricing review with Vivek and Rishi tomorrow or Friday?

Marissa
